environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed with Function URL AuthType: AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the Lambda function specifies a Condition block requiring 'aws:PrincipalOrgID' matching the organization ID 'o-a1b2c3d4e5', and the Action is limited to 'lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl'. There is no public-facing invoke permission (no wildcard principal). The function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 '{"Message":"Forbidden"}' for any request that does not include a valid SigV4 signature from an IAM principal within the specified AWS Organization. Additionally, the only IAM roles with lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission are two service roles (backend-aggregator-role and monitoring-health-check-role) which are constrained by a permissions boundary (ProductionServiceBoundary) that limits their request payloads via a Service Control Policy denying sts:AssumeRole to external accounts.
